test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following launched ADITI 2.0 challenges and DISC 12 to foster innovation, entrepreneurship and ‘Aatmanirbharta’ in defence during DefConnect 4.0 on 7 October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Rajnath Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shri Rajnath Singh launched the ADITI 2.0 challenges and DISC 12 during DefConnect 4.0 on 7 October 2024.
 
• ADITI 2.0 aims to foster innovation and entrepreneurship in the defence sector.
 
• DISC 12 is part of the Defence India Startup Challenge series to promote 'Aatmanirbharta' or self-reliance in defence technologies.
 
• DefConnect 4.0 is an event organized to boost the defence startup ecosystem in India.
 
• The initiatives are intended to strengthen the collaboration between the government and the private sector in defence innovations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence India Startup Challenge (DISC):**

 
 
• DISC is a flagship initiative under the Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX) framework.
 
• It encourages startups to develop products and solutions for defence and aerospace sectors.
 
• The challenge involves problem statements identified by the armed forces and is open to Indian startups and MSMEs.
 
• iDEX provides funding, mentorship, and support to the selected startups.
 
 
 
• **Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX):**
 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Defence in 2018 to foster innovation and technology development in defence.
 
• iDEX aims to create an ecosystem that supports and nurtures startups and innovators.
 
• It provides access to defence testing facilities, funding, and expert mentorship.
 
• iDEX is managed by the Defence Innovation Organisation (DIO), a not-for-profit company set up by the Ministry of Defence.
 
 
 
• **Aatmanirbhar Bharat:**
 
 
• A flagship initiative by the Government of India to make the country self-reliant.
 
• It focuses on promoting local manufacturing, reducing dependency on imports, and boosting domestic industries.
 
• The initiative spans various sectors, including defence, healthcare, agriculture, and infrastructure.
 
• It aims to make India a global manufacturing hub by leveraging its demographic and technological advantages.
 
 
 
• **DefConnect:**
 
 
• DefConnect is an event organized by the Ministry of Defence to showcase innovations in the defence sector.
 
• It provides a platform for startups, MSMEs, and innovators to interact with the defence establishment.
 
• The event includes exhibitions, panel discussions, and networking opportunities.
 
• DefConnect aims to strengthen the collaboration between the government, industry, and academia.
